title: Deep Pattern Matching in Function Heads & Simultaneous Aliasing
solutionExplanation: Uses nested tuple patterns directly in function heads with top-to-bottom clause ordering and pattern aliasing.

otpDocCards.description: Multi-clause pattern matching and simultaneous term aliasing in function heads.
otpDocCards.complexityNote: Compiled by BEAM into O(1) decision trees of jump tables.

mentalModelCheck.question: What is the primary operational benefit of using simultaneous aliasing ({packet, ...} = FullPacket) in a function head?

options.label: It avoids reconstructing the outer tuple, pointing directly to the existing term on the heap in O(1)
options.explanation: Aliasing binds the existing heap term to FullPacket without allocating memory or rebuilding fields.

options.label: It converts the tuple into an Erlang ETS table record automatically
options.explanation: ETS tables are separate in-memory storage facilities and are not related to pattern matching.

options.label: It creates a mutable reference that updates the caller environment
options.explanation: Erlang terms are strictly immutable; aliasing creates a local variable binding to the existing immutable term.
